ambient_events: The ashen cut holds still air and the ghost of creosote from a railway long gone.
Bootprints and other prints share the floor of the cut; some of the others are not shaped right.
description: A cutting sliced through the spoil where a rail line once ran out to the Slagworks and was torn up for scrap decades back. The cut is sheltered from the wind, which is why the things that shelter here resent visitors.
name: Ashen Cut
